mapper.insert: INSERT INTO long_term_memory (user_id, thread_slug, content, memory_type, keywords, relevance_score, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{threadSlug}, #{content}, #{memoryType}, #{keywords}, #{relevanceScore}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE long_term_memory SET content = #{content}, memory_type = #{memoryType}, keywords = #{keywords}, relevance_score = #{relevanceScore}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
